description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git's reverse index functionality, including setup, verification, and corruption testing of reverse indexes in pack files.

methods.name: test_index_pack
methods.description: Function to test indexing a pack file with different 'pack.writeReverseIndex' configurations, removing existing reverse index files as needed.

methods.name: corrupt_rev_and_verify
methods.description: Function to corrupt parts of the reverse index file at a specified position with a given value and verify that 'git fsck' detects the corruption.
